title: 2020 roadmap on pore materials for energy and environmental applications
claim: Combining atomic-scale and in situ characterization with electronic-structure calculations is a route to testing proposed active sites in porous metal oxides.
explanation: The review identifies microscopy and in situ spectroscopies for examining pore-adjacent structure and DFT for relating electronic structure and intermediate binding to catalytic behavior.
scope: Mechanistic study of porous metal-oxide electrocatalysts.
conditions: Measurements and models must represent the relevant catalytic state.
caveats: The review presents these tools as means to resolve, rather than already having resolved, active-site and selectivity questions.
